tool_input.description: Double-check no production caller of mission.Store.Update via other var names

tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(mission): preserve absolute/relative distinction in path canonicalization

splitSegments dropped the leading empty segment strings.Split produces
for an absolute path, so CanonicalPath("/docs/x.md") and
CanonicalPath("docs/x.md") collapsed to the identical string and a
relative glob write_set entry (docs/**) wrongly contained an absolute
target (ethos-vaib, docs/spec-writeset-admission.tex).

splitSegments now returns the absoluteness flag alongside segments.
pathContainedBy requires file and entry to agree on absoluteness before
comparing segments — the spec's own fixed predicate states
"absolute(file) = false" since its ENTRY model never represents an
absolute entry, but pathContainedBy is also called with a legitimately
absolute entry (the verifier's own contract.yaml path on the
PreToolUse allowlist), so containment requires absoluteness agreement
rather than an unconditional relative-file requirement. CanonicalPath
preserves the leading slash on an absolute input's canonical form.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <[redacted-email]>
EOF
)" internal/mission/conflict.go internal/mission/conflict_test.go
